description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade Java runtime from version 17 to 21 (latest LTS)
tasks.reason: Java 17 is approaching end of active support. Upgrading to Java 21 ensures access to the latest LTS features, virtual threads, performance improvements, and long-term security updates. Spring Boot 3.x already supports Java 21, so no framework migration is needed.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the Java runtime from Java 17 to Java 21 across all modules (web and worker). Update Maven compiler source/target settings and toolchain configurations to Java 21. Ensure all code is compatible with Java 21. Run existing tests to validate no regressions.

tasks.description: Migrate RabbitMQ AMQP messaging to Azure Service Bus
tasks.reason: RabbitMQ requires self-managed infrastructure and uses plaintext credentials (guest/guest). Migrating to Azure Service Bus provides a fully managed messaging service with enterprise-grade reliability, scalability, and native Azure Managed Identity authentication.
tasks.requirements: Migrate both the web and worker modules from RabbitMQ (AMQP) to Azure Service Bus. Replace RabbitMQ AMQP connection configuration and Spring AMQP client code with Azure Service Bus SDK. Use Managed Identity for credential-free authentication. Remove plaintext RabbitMQ credentials. Preserve existing message producer/consumer patterns and queue semantics used for thumbnail generation workflow.

tasks.description: Migrate AWS S3 file storage to Azure Blob Storage
tasks.reason: The application uses AWS SDK v2 S3 for asset storage with plaintext access keys. Migrating to Azure Blob Storage provides native Azure integration, eliminates cross-cloud latency, and enables Managed Identity for secure, credential-free access without hardcoded AWS keys.
tasks.requirements: Replace AWS SDK v2 S3 client with Azure Blob Storage SDK in both the web and worker modules. Migrate file upload, download, and asset management operations to Azure Blob Storage APIs. Use Managed Identity for credential-free authentication. Remove AWS accessKeyId and accessKey configuration properties. Preserve existing storage behavior for assets and thumbnails.

tasks.description: Migrate PostgreSQL to Azure Database for PostgreSQL with Managed Identity
tasks.reason: PostgreSQL is currently running on-premises with username/password authentication. Migrating to Azure Database for PostgreSQL with Managed Identity eliminates hardcoded credentials, reduces operational overhead, and provides a fully managed, scalable, and highly available database service.
tasks.requirements: Update both the web and worker modules to connect to Azure Database for PostgreSQL using Azure SDK and Managed Identity for secure, credential-free authentication. Replace local PostgreSQL JDBC connection configuration with Azure-compatible settings. Remove plaintext database credentials. Preserve existing Spring Data JPA and Hibernate data access patterns and schema.

tasks.description: Generate and run integration tests for Azure service migrations
tasks.reason: Validate that all migrated Azure services (Service Bus, Blob Storage, Azure Database for PostgreSQL) work correctly end-to-end after migration, ensuring functional parity with the original on-premises and AWS-based services.
tasks.requirements: Generate Layer 1 (Local Integration with TestContainers) and Layer 2 (Smoke Tests) for all Azure service migrations
